text:
Sam: quick Q — AcmeCorp POC needs a super-light evidence bundle to run an eval. They asked for: SOC2 excerpt, signed pen-test letter, a presigned upload for artifacts, and clarity on Dedicated pricing/burst. Who can own each piece?
Lina: I can pull the SOC2 excerpt + control mapping. Do they need the whole CC or just controls for storage/networking?
Sam: just storage/networking controls + KMS separation note. EU residency too.
Lina: noted. we should redact any internal IPs and customer PII before sharing. I'll prepare an excerpt + short explainer paragraph about KMS (we never share keys).
Oscar: For the signed pen-test letter — Legal needs to sign off on the template and the pen-test vendor attestation. @Ben legal?
Ben: I can sign the pen-test letter template once I get the vendor name and the POC company contact. I may need a one-line scope phrase. Send me the redline requests.
Sam: vendor = RedScan Labs, POContact = diana@acme.com. Scope line: "external webapp & staging network scan for POC window".
Maddy: I can create a presigned S3 URL (24h) for them to upload artifacts and also produce the staging IP list for external scans. Command I'll run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpacks/acme-5123/poc-bundle.zip --expires-in 86400`
Sam: perfect. Also they asked if Dedicated includes burst at commit price or extra — need a clear number to avoid sticker shock.
Oscar: short answer: burst is allowed but billable. Typical uplift is ~20% above committed hourly for short bursts; we can provide a quote with exact numbers. cc @salesops for final quote.
Sam: ok — Ben can you aim to get the signed pen-test letter out by EOD? Maddy — presigned URL + IP list by EOD? Lina — SOC2 excerpt + KMS paragraph by EOD?
Ben: I'll draft now, ping me if they want custom signatory language.
Maddy: creating presign + IP list now, will share link once generated.
Lina: prepping excerpt now, will exclude full report and instead include an index of evidence artifacts.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: for EU residency shipments please ensure the bundle has customer PII redacted and retention note included.
Sam: thanks team — I'll consolidate into a single package to send to Diana and track responses. :thumbsup:
Oscar: pro tip — include a one-page "what we share / what we don't" doc to reduce back-and-forth.
Sam: good idea, will do.
Ben: signed template sent (uploaded).
Maddy: presign URL: https://s3-presign.example/abcd1234 (expires in 24h) + staging IPs: 34.120.5.10, 34.120.5.11 (scan window 0300-0700 UTC).
Sam: sent to Diana, she asked for a slightly longer presign window (48h) — can we extend?
Maddy: can reissue 48h if legal is ok with retention exposure.
Ben: 48h fine for POC.
Sam: awesome. closing this thread once they ack.
